body:
The existing coupled SHIFT_STEP can sample a late SPI reply too early. This PR retains the counterexample, compares real eight-word/ten-word implementations, and now qualifies written executor properties of the compact phase-separated candidate. **Production and candidate RTL remain unchanged in this formal increment.**

SPI needs to prepare outgoing data and observe replies at different times. Compact DRIVE combines TX preparation with an auxiliary GPIO update; delayed SAMPLE captures later. That fits the existing eight slots and avoids the larger loader's cost and compatibility changes.

| Alternative | Actual words | Generic cells | State bits | Legacy simulation |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Existing, faster target only | 8 | 2,793 | 410 | 17/17 PASS |
| Compact phase instructions | 8 | 3,107 | 412 | 17/17 PASS |
| Ten-word/banked loader | 10 | 3,403 | 477 | 16 PASS / 1 declared FAIL |

The banked length-nine failure and E0020's coupled `0x69 -> 0xb4` late-response failure remain failures. The faster-target/no-RTL option remains conditional, and neither this comparison nor the new proof qualifies complete SPI.

### New formal qualification

[Contract](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/blob/284c9cc6e6f6b5b70403a3ab2b704205eac3b861/docs/specs/spi-phase-formal.md), [D23](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/blob/284c9cc6e6f6b5b70403a3ab2b704205eac3b861/docs/decisions/0023-partial-phase-formal-qualification.md), [E0022](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/tree/284c9cc6e6f6b5b70403a3ab2b704205eac3b861/evidence/E0022-compact-phase-formal), [runner/harness](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/tree/284c9cc6e6f6b5b70403a3ab2b704205eac3b861/experiments/spi_phase).

| Task | Configured mode/depth | Local and hosted result |
|---|---|---|
| Phase properties | prove / 8 | PASS by k-induction, successful step 6; base 0..7 |
| Legacy refinement | prove / 12 | PASS by k-induction, successful step 10; base 0..11 |
| Phase covers | cover / 40 | All 10 reachable; latest 25 |
| Legacy covers | cover / 40 | All 3 reachable; latest 17 |
| Decrement-by-two mutant | BMC / 8 | Expected **FAIL at 4**, witness retained |
| Sample7-commit mutant | BMC / 20 | Expected **FAIL at 14**, witness retained |

Safety assumes only reset on the first sampled edge. All subsequent instruction/valid, enable/reset, synchronized input bits and both payloads are symbolic. No fixed pins/order, stable program, eventual enable or fairness is assumed. The counter retains all 16 bits: induction proves the load/decrement/freeze/capture recurrence, not a 65,535-edge completion trace or wall-clock liveness.

The paired legacy job excludes the two newly allocated manual phase types only at an enabled valid RUN fetch in the unchanged reference engine. Every previous legal instruction remains admitted; ignored-cycle instructions remain free. It compares all shared architectural state/status and GPIO/result outputs. This is legacy-only refinement from reset, not equivalence of new phase programs or every formerly invalid word.

Properties cover reset priority, freeze/terminal hold, sequencing, full-width pending delay with latched operands, GPIO/TX/RX progression, phase payload-slot stability, rejection/no false writes and eighth-sample commit. Covers include maximum-delay entry/decrement, reset and disable during pending work, valid byte completion and a legacy byte after a phase byte. Formal-only readout instrumentation adds no inputs/state/clock; its inverse mechanically recovers the unchanged candidate.

Initial induction **UNKNOWN** (unreachable RUN/period1 cut state) and a status-parser failure are retained. Nonzero-period-implies-WAIT was added as an assertion, not an input restriction. The parser now validates SBY's optional numeric status fields while preserving raw status. No candidate fix was needed.

### Validation and provenance

- Existing locked-image Doctor PASS, no local image build/pull, installs or storage cleanup.
- `make check`:35 Python cases plus metadata/learning checks PASS; atlas consistency PASS.
- All six formal tasks achieve required outcomes; mutants stay FAIL in the artifacts. The runner requires induction summaries, exact 10/3 cover counts, counterexample/cover witnesses and strict actual statuses.
- Tested input, protected-source, curated-artifact and committed Git-blob SHA-256 checks PASS. All five uninstrumented compact source hashes match E0021.
- No new local RTL simulation is claimed for unchanged candidate RTL. The earlier E0021 dual-simulator/public-pin measurements are retained; new exact-head CI reruns the production ladder, comparison and isolated formal job separately.
- CI retains exact proof inputs, configs, status/logs and raw cover/counterexample VCD/SMTC/Yosys witnesses. Curated evidence retains selected signals, original hashes, exact mutant replay data and failed attempts.
- [E0021](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/tree/284c9cc6e6f6b5b70403a3ab2b704205eac3b861/evidence/E0021-spi-phase-comparison) retains measured storage/cost comparisons. [The prior PR checkpoint](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/blob/284c9cc6e6f6b5b70403a3ab2b704205eac3b861/evidence/E0022-compact-phase-formal/prior-pr11-checkpoint.json) archives the older `f0c41fc` exact-head CI/artifact audit.

Current head: **`284c9cc6e6f6b5b70403a3ab2b704205eac3b861`**. All five fresh exact-head workflows PASS. Both verification artifacts have been independently audited below.

### Scope and next action

Draft/unmerged; main stays `ae13f6bfcfd3fe21cd937768bc9e1151f441379c`. Production RTL, official ports/config, 6x4 allocation, visualizer and learning record are unchanged. PR8/compiler remain deferred; no imports/rebase/merge, hardware, deployment, security changes or physical flow.

Next: prove actual compact-copy result-store capture and public loader/reset abort integration. This is partial written executor qualification under synchronized digital inputs/effective reset. Integrated-chip formal proof, complete four-mode/continuous SPI, I2C, electrical/physical timing/Fmax and silicon remain NOT_EVALUATED. H1-H4 remain unproven; owner M0 fluency remains PENDING.


### Exact-head hosted completion and independent artifact audit

All five runs report head `284c9cc6e6f6b5b70403a3ab2b704205eac3b861` and terminal **success**:

| Workflow | Trigger | Result |
|---|---|---|
| test | push | [PASS · 41703689251](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/actions/runs/41703689251) |
| test | PR | [PASS · 41703698972](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/actions/runs/41703698972) |
| atlas | push | [PASS · 41703689160](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/actions/runs/41703689160) |
| atlas | PR | [PASS · 41703698997](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/actions/runs/41703698997) |
| docs | push | [PASS · 41703689071](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/actions/runs/41703689071) |

Both hosted test workflows pass the production ladder, Windows host lessons, all11 collector stages, all12 comparison stages, all six required formal outcomes and uploads. Artifact JUnit independently confirms **19/19 Icarus**, **19/19 Verilator**, one GL-shaped smoke and one archived-learning waveform group, with zero failure/skip in those production suites. The comparison's intentionally incompatible banked-loader JUnit still contains its declared failure.

Both ZIPs were downloaded and independently audited in memory:

| Artifact | Clean checkout | ZIP bytes | Independently computed SHA-256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| [13265628132 · push](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/actions/runs/41703689251/artifacts/13265628132) | `284c9cc6e6f6b5b70403a3ab2b704205eac3b861` | 1,955,483 | `ebe6c0cddd9d0d5ebd92f7726d4023a1f6e3777ff7a0f36b67c6e4f4231e8dd1` |
| [13265019190 · PR](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/actions/runs/41703698972/artifacts/13265019190) | `b3ed8489bf767bfc57ffa32d3b1abbb9239fcf3e` (synthetic merge) | 1,955,733 | `26406160155cd0e28a0bd4d778c70bab32be771eb8078277b38d7aa9b41dae15` |

Each digest matches GitHub's metadata. The PR checkout is GitHub's test integration commit, not a merge into main. The audit verifies:
- clean recorded checkout, tested input hashes against the requested committed head, exact generated proof-input hashes and unchanged compact candidate;
- every collector retained-file checksum, production JUnit, comparison JUnit/failure accounting and recursive complete-chip netlist counts;
- actual SBY modes/depths/status files and logs, successful induction summaries, all10/3 cover obligations and retained raw witnesses;
- both deliberately faulty variants remain FAIL for the intended reason: raw VCD shows pending count2 becoming0 after an enabled edge, and a write pulse with six prior samples while the expected-write predicate is0 (first failure step14).

Hosted proof results reproduce local E0022: phase induction at step6 with base0..7, legacy refinement at step10 with base0..11, ten phase covers reached by25 and three legacy covers by17, and expected mutation failures at4/14 under BMC depths8/20. Cover horizon is40. The full16-bit recurrence is proved; no 65,535-edge completion trace, fairness, integrated-chip proof, physical timing or full-SPI qualification follows.

No hosted failure required a source/config fix. No new commit was made for this completion audit: requested head remains unchanged. PR11 is still draft/unmerged, main remains `ae13f6bfcfd3fe21cd937768bc9e1151f441379c`, and PR8 remains draft/unmerged at `b19a718e25b2f6e3343a15a1632aaed7da14c05f`. Production RTL, compiler deferral, visualizer and pending M0 owner fluency are unchanged.
